contexts.text: (Animals) which are useful for life; as that they can be eaten.
Not to eat () = not to commingle.

Regarded in itself, to eat the flesh of animals is a profane kind of thing; for in the most ancient time they never ate the flesh of any beast or bird; but only seeds, especially bread made from wheat; and also the fruits of trees, vegetables, and milk and its products, as butter. To slay animals and eat their flesh, would have been wickedness to them, and in like manner that of wild animals... But in process of time, when man began to become... more ferocious than the wild beasts, they first began to slay animals and eat their flesh. And as man was of such a character, it was permitted, and is permitted also at this day; and so far as he does it from conscience it is allowable... Wherefore also at this day no one is condemned from the fact that he eats flesh.
Hence it is now evident, that not to eat the flesh in its soul, the blood = not to commingle profane things with holy ones.

That Aaron and his sons should eat up the residue, represented what is reciprocal of man, and appropriation, thus conjunction through love and charity; wherefore it was commanded that they should eat it in the holy place... AC 2187.
They did eat () = communication thus. To eat = to be communicated, also to be conjoined. AC 2343.

The sanctified things were from the sacrifices, which were not burnt upon the altar, and were eaten up either by the priests, or by the people who offered them. Illustrated. That the unclean were not to eat of them. Illustrated. (See Feast.) The like was represented by the fact that Aaron and his sons were to eat up the breads of faces in the holy place, .
Under Nazarite, see this reference.
See Eat here.
To eat is predicated of what is celestial.
A state of vastated good is signified by they shall eat bread by weight ().
See Eat here.
To eat, and to drink in the Lord's Kingdom ()... = the appropriation of the good of love and of the truth of faith.
The eagle that hasteth to devour () = to desolate man as to truths.
He hath devoured in devouring our silver () = the truth of these affections which he would consume, unless they were separated. To devour = to consume.
The rams of thy flock have I not eaten () = that the truth of good took nothing of this... To eat = to appropriate to one's self, thus to take...
Before they built altars they made heaps and ate upon them, for a witness that they were conjoined in love.
They ate there upon the heap () = appropriation from good Divine. To eat = communication, conjunction, and appropriation. References.

(Jacob) called his brethren to eat bread () = the appropriation of good by the Lord's Divine Natural... Among the Ancients, eatings and feasts signified appropriation and conjunction through love and charity.
Who ate up the fat of the sacrifices () = that they destroyed the good of worship; and drank the wine of their drink-offering = that they destroyed the truth of worship.
To eat and drink (the flesh and blood of the Son of man) = to appropriate them to themselves... To eat = to appropriate good; and to drink, to appropriate truth. References.
To eat flesh and drink blood () = to appropriate to themselves Divine good and Divine truth, thus the Holy which proceeds from the Lord's Divine Human. DSS 15:3. AE 617:24. AE 650:47.
They sat down to eat bread () = the appropriation of evil from falsity.
They who eat the bread in the Holy Supper unworthily, do not appropriate to themselves good, but evil.

When the Ancients came to any remarkable determination, which was confirmed by the rest, it was usual for them to eat together; by which was signified that they approved, and thus that they appropriated it to themselves. Illustrated.
An evil beast hath devoured him () = that the cupidities of evil have extinguished... To devour = to extinguish, because it is predicated of the truths of the Church.
To devour widows' houses () = to deprive of truths those who long for them, and to teach falsities.

The kine evil in aspect... devoured () = that the falsities which are not of faith... would exterminate. To devour = to consume; here, to exterminate, because the truths which are in the Natural, before they are... regenerated, are as it were exterminated through falsities.
When they had completed to eat up the provision () = when truths failed.
The men shall eat with me at noon () = that they will be conjoined when with the medium. To eat = to be communicated, conjoined, and appropriated. References.
They heard that they were to eat bread there () = the apperception that good was to be adjoined to truths.
The Egyptians cannot eat bread with the Hebrews () = that they cannot possibly be conjoined with the good and truth of the Church.
Ye shall eat the fat of the land () = the appropriation of good there.
They ate their appointed portion which Pharaoh gave them () = that goods did not appropriate to themselves more than according to the ordination.
He shall devour the prey () = to appropriate to Himself those whom He has seized and delivered.
To devour = to be consumed.
To devour = consumption.
To devour = to consume. AC 7689.
To eat = appropriation. AC 7894. AC 8503. AC 8682. AC 9289. AC 9391:11. AC 10650. AC 10656.
To eat, here, = enjoyment, because it treats of a state of initiation. AC 7850. AC 7855. AC 7856.
He that eateth what is leavened () = he who appropriates to himself what is false. AC 8051.
Ye shall eat what is unleavened () = the appropriation of truth from good. AC 7910. AC 8058.

No son of a stranger shall eat thereof () = that those who are not in truth and good are separated from them... Not to eat it = not to communicate and be conjoined with them; thus to be separated from them. In what follows it treats of those who should eat the passover together, and of those who should not eat it.
Under Feast, see these references. AC 9412.
Then shall he eat it () = that he shall be with them... Hence it is that to eat = to be with them, or to be consociated; and not to eat = not to be with them, or to be separated. AC 8002. AC 8012.
In one house it shall be eaten () = consociations of accordant goods so that they make one good. For the paschal supper represented the angelic consociations in Heaven... AC 8006.

It devoured them as stubble () = devastation and damnation thence of themselves. To devour = to consume; and, in the spiritual sense, to devastate and damn; for the consumption of those who are in evil is devastation and damnation...
(The inhabitants of Jupiter) take delight in eating long, not so much from the enjoyment of the food, as of that of the conversation at that time.
They eat in their tents.
The Sons of Israel ate manna forty years () = the appropriation of the good of truth in the state of all temptations. AC 8539.
The reason the flesh of the sacrifices was eaten, was that there might be represented the appropriation of celestial good; and also consociation through love.
Its flesh shall not be eaten () = that this evil shall by no means be appropriated, but shall be cast out.
Flesh torn in the field ye shall not eat () = that the falsified good of faith shall not be cod joined.
To eat = communication and conjunction. AC 9276.
They ate and drank () = information concerning the good and truth of worship. Explained. AC 9412:end.

A devouring fire to the eyes of the Sons of Israel () = that it was injurious and vastating with those who were in its external separated from an internal... To devour = to consume, thus to injure and vastate. Illustrated.
To eat the riches of the gentiles () = to appropriate goods to themselves.
To eat = to appropriate. AC 10283:6. AE 556:10.
Its Receptive was signified by the breads which (Aaron and his sons) ate.
Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram () = the appropriation of spiritual good with those who are in internal things from the Lord. AC 10107. AC 10109.
A stranger shall not eat () = no appropriation of good with those who do not acknowledge the Lord.
Hence it is evident, that the profanation of what is holy is signified by to eat the flesh and bread of the sacrifice on the following day ().
To eat to the left, and not to be satisfied () = that however they are instructed about good and truth they will never receive.
To devour () = to consume, thus to destroy ( = to reject. AE 1082).
That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and of chief captains, etc () = the appropriation of goods from the Lord through the truths of the Word and of doctrine thence, in every sense, degree, and kind.
Dogs... = those especially who are in the pleasure of eating and drinking, and in which alone they take delight.
In Heaven, equally as in the world... there are eatings and feasts...
The eatings of the Sons of Israel from the sacrifices... signified nothing else than unanimity in the worship of Jehovah.

A vision... concerning those who have been given to eatings... At dinner time an Angel spoke to me, saying that I should not indulge the stomach too much at table. While he was with me, there clearly appeared to me as it were a vapour exuding from the pores of the body... which sank down to the ground... where the collected vapour was turned into various little worms, which being gathered under the table, blazed up in a moment with a noise. Seeing a fiery light therein, and hearing the noise, I thought that thus all the little worms which could be generated from an immoderate appetite were cast out from my body, thus were burnt, and that I was purified from them. Hence it may be inferred, what luxuries and the like things carry in their bosom.
To the left... are they who devour human flesh, and who devour each other, their teeth sticking in each other's shoulders, and thus satisfying their starving appetites.
In regard to many things which I ate and drank (a sphere arose which, by certain Spirits, could not be endured).
In other Hells they devour shocking things...
As the eatings of things sacrificed to Jehovah signified the appropriation of good, the eatings of the sacrifices which were for the gods of the gentiles... signified the appropriation of evil.
The dissipation of falsities and evils is signified by to devour the prey.
The Lord's flesh = the Divine good of His Divine love; and to eat it = to receive it, to appropriate it to ourselves, and thus to be conjoined with the Lord.
To eat fine flour, honey, and oil () = to appropriate truth and good.
To eat () = to appropriate to ourselves, which is done by application as of ourselves.
To fall and to eat to these things () = to inquire. AE 600:13.
To eat = to extinguish.
To eat and drink = for goods and truths to be communicated and appropriated.
To devour = to lay waste and to consume.
To eat up = to consume and to deprive.
To eat and not be satisfied () = because truth from good is so little and so rare that it would yield scarcely any nourishment for the soul.
It devoured and brake in pieces () = it perverted and destroyed.
To devour, or eat up = to conjoin and appropriate to one's self; and as the Word is conjoined with man through reading and perception, to devour or eat up here = to read and perceive.

In the Word, to eat and drink also = to eat and drink spiritually, which is to be instructed, and, by means of instruction and life, to imbue and appropriate to one's self good and truth, and therefore intelligence and wisdom. Illustrated.
To eat up () manifestly = to eat up spiritually, which is to know, to perceive, and to appropriate to one's self; for it is said that I may eat thy words...
In the opposite sense, to eat and drink = to appropriate to one's self evil and falsity, and thence to be conjoined with Hell. Illustrated.
To eat (the book) = to perceive, and thus to appropriate to one's self.
To eat = to be appropriated. AE 730:38. AE 739:end. AE 840:2. AE 1082:7.
They shall eat it and praise Jehovah () = appropriation and the worship of the Lord.
To eat = instruction and appropriation.
To eat their fruit () = the enjoyment of the goods which belong to the regenerate man, and the joyousnesses from them.
It hath devoured her fruit () = the consumption of good.
A hungry one who as it were eateth = as it were a longing for good with which he may be nourished.
To devour them like a savage lion () = the destruction and devastation of all the truth of the Word, and thence of the Church.
Eat ye that which is good () = to appropriate to themselves good.
